title: HumanoidToolBench: Benchmarking Humanoid Tool Use from Selection to Mobile Execution
abstract: arXiv:2610.02089v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: As robotic hardware and learning methods advance, humanoids need tools to perform tasks beyond their inherent physical limits. Successful tool use requires selecting a suitable tool and coordinating manipulation and, when needed, locomotion to complete the task. Existing benchmarks do not jointly evaluate these capabilities on a humanoid. We introduce HumanoidToolBench, an 18-task benchmark spanning three scenarios, three execution levels, and two tool-set modes, together with ToolBook, a dataset of 3.1k demonstrations collected in simulation and on a real Unitree G1. Evaluation of seven policies in simulation and three on the real robot reveals substantial gaps between selecting a suitable tool and completing the task. Focused GR00T N1.7 probes show reduced selection accuracy on unseen tools and continued task execution under unrelated instructions. Code and data are available at https://snu-pi.github.io/HumanoidToolBench/.

translated_title: HumanoidToolBench：从工具选择到移动执行的人形机器人工具使用基准测试
translated_abstract: 随着机器人硬件和学习方法的进步，人形机器人需要使用工具来完成超出其固有物理能力极限的任务。成功的工具使用需要选择合适的工具，并协调操作行为，在需要时协调移动以完成任务。现有的基准测试并未在人形机器人上对这些能力进行联合评估。我们提出了HumanoidToolBench，这是一个包含18个任务的基准测试，涵盖三种场景、三个执行级别和两种工具集模式，同时推出了ToolBook数据集，包含在仿真中和真实Unitree G1机器人上采集的3.1k条示范数据。对仿真中的七个策略和真实机器人上的三个策略的评估显示，在“选择合适的工具”与“完成任务”之间存在显著差距。针对GR00T N1.7的聚焦探针实验表明，模型在未见过的工具上选择准确率下降，且在无关指令下仍会继续执行任务。
tldr: 提出了HumanoidToolBench基准测试和ToolBook数据集，首次在人形机器人上联合评估从工具选择到移动执行的全流程工具使用能力，并揭示了现有策略在工具泛化与指令遵循方面的显著缺陷。
en_tdlr: Introduces HumanoidToolBench, an 18-task benchmark, and the ToolBook dataset to jointly evaluate humanoid tool use from selection to mobile execution, revealing significant gaps in tool generalization and instruction following.
